title: Completed show discloses an unavailable evaluated provenance distinctly from legacy omission
outcome: A completed item whose evaluated seal binding cannot be validated reads with an explicit unavailable provenance rather than the shape of an intentional legacy omission, while integrity and completion checks stay strict
acceptance: a_broken_evaluated_seal_binding_is_disclosed_as_unavailable_provenance passes: on a reachable missing or forged evaluation binding of a completed evaluated seal, show text and JSON carry an explicit unavailable provenance with its error class instead of omitting the block; a legacy completed show keeps no acceptance key; doctor, completion, and open-item reads are unchanged
